text:
oliver: Hey folks, accepted the org invite via the GitHub mobile app on my phone, but when I try to push from my laptop I get: \"remote: Permission to redwood/infra-scripts.git denied to oliver.dev.\" I can see the org in my browser though. Who should I ping?

rachel: Welcome! Mobile app accept can sometimes create a different account mapping if you accepted while logged into a personal account on mobile. Do you see your work handle on github.com?

oliver: On browser it shows oliver-dev (work), but mobile shows oliver.personal as the accepting actor in the invite email. I did enable 2FA and added my SSH key on the work account.

eva: Hi Oliver 1. Likely an outside-collab / alias edge-case. Can you paste the output of `ssh -T git@github.com` and `gh auth status`? No creds, just paste the GH usernames it reports.

oliver: ssh -T reports: \"Hi oliver-dev! You've successfully authenticated...\" gh auth status shows I'm logged in as oliver-dev. Yet push is denied. Screenshot attached: \"remote: error: protected branch\" but I don't have push perms.

platform-bot: Onboarding note: oliver (oliver@redwood.ai)  Invite accepted (mobile) with different GitHub handle detected (oliver.personal). SSO: enabled; SSH key: present. Flagging for platform team.

eva: Thanks. I checked org membership: oliver-dev exists but team auto-assign didn't run because the invite was initially accepted by oliver.personal. I can either add oliver-dev to infra-scripts temporarily, or revoke the mobile acceptance and resend invite to oliver@redwood.ai. Which do you want?

oliver: Temporary add is fine, I need to push to trigger a deployment. Also curious if this is common — maybe onboarding doc should mention mobile accept caveat.

rachel: Adding note to docs sounds good. For now, eva, please add write perms and relax branch protection for a single push to let them open PR.

eva: Done: granted write to infra-scripts for oliver-dev, re-ran team sync against both handles, and added a one-time bypass for branch protection on the branch oliver/push-fix. Try pushing with: 
```bash
git checkout -b fix/ci-hook
# change
 git add . && git commit -m \"fix(ci): update hook\"
git push --set-upstream origin fix/ci-hook
```

oliver: Push succeeded and PR opened. CI started. Thanks! Logged a quick note on ONB-512 to remind new hires not to accept invites from mobile if logged into personal GH.

onboard-bot: Logged suggestion ONB-512: add mobile-invite troubleshooting + alias detection to onboarding docs.

rachel: Great, closing this thread once CI passes. Welcome aboard Oliver! :wave:
